title: Malmgren's IDA work a cover for the NSC; Bissell diaries
place_text: Institute for Defense Analyses / White House

tellings.quote: And he said in a 2024 interview before he interviewed with me that his work at the IDA was actually a cover for what he was doing for the National Security Council in the White House.

plain: A man named Harold Malmgren, whom Michels later interviewed, is said to have claimed that his 1960s work at the Institute for Defense Analyses was really a cover for work he was doing for the National Security Council in the White House. Michels says Malmgren said this in a 2024 interview given before their own conversation, and he ties the story to Malmgren's diaries and to a man named Richard Bissell. If true, it would mean that a defence research job hid quieter work at the very top of government.
